notes: Adds admin accounts for Dan to manage registered players. Set ADMIN_EMAILS (comma-separated) in the environment - any account signing up or logging in with one of those emails lands on a dedicated 'Admin' screen instead of the normal My Games dashboard, with zero game-playing UI. The admin screen lists every registered account (name, email, registered date, game count, active/disabled status) with buttons to Disable, Enable, Reset password (hands back the reset link directly, useful since SMTP likely isn't configured), and Delete. Disabling/deleting kicks that account's live connection immediately (forces a socket reconnect which then gets rejected) rather than waiting for their next natural reconnect - login is also blocked outright for a disabled account with a clear error message. Deleting is blocked if the account is still GM of an active game (transfer or delete that game first) and admin accounts themselves can't be disabled or deleted this way. Admin status is computed fresh from ADMIN_EMAILS on every request, nothing stored on the account, so revoking is just an env var edit + restart. To test: set ADMIN_EMAILS to an email, sign up/log in with it and confirm the Admin screen (no game UI) appears; have a second, non-admin account sign up and confirm it shows up in the admin table; disable it and confirm that account gets bounced to the login screen immediately and can't log back in until re-enabled; try Reset password and confirm a reset link is shown; make a third account the GM of a game and confirm deleting it is blocked with a clear error until the game is dealt with; confirm a plain account with no games deletes cleanly.
